profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A native New Yorker turned Coloradan, Guevara is a highly motivated programmer who enjoys data-driven work and getting hands-on with code. During his undergrad, he learned a variety of coding languages including Python, Java, JavaScript, and SQL. C# was added to his repertoire during his time at FIS Global. He used this language alongside frameworks such as ASP.NET, Winforms, and WPF. In his free time, Guevara enjoys spending time with his family, playing video games, and increasing his familiarity with coding tools for Web, Mobile, and AI applications.

Guevara was selected from an applicant pool of 400+ to serve as a student and Fellow for a full stack JavaScript training program, CUNY Tech Prep. During this program he learned: 

-In-demand technologies such as React, Node + Express, and PostgreSQL 
-Industry best practices for design, implementation, and deployment such as MVC, version control with Git/GitHub, agile & scrum with Trello and Slack, test driven development, and CI/CD

Past Projects Include: 

-Worked with a team of 4 to implement an Android application, which allows users to understand how to categorize and recycle different forms of waste.
-Created and formed a database using​ ​Room, ViewModel, and LiveData ​to store different forms of waste such as compost, plastics, and biodegradable materials.
-Worked on a team of 3 people to implement a functional ​language learning application that aids users by having them interact with native speakers of said language.
-Implemented with Postgres, Express, React, Amazon Translator API to ​receive a translated message from the foreign language speaker you are texting​.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Maintain and improve a service that will allow users to automate QA validation for the QA Automation team locally and via cloud.
-Use of technologies such as ASP.Net and MySQL, as well as industry best practices for design, implementation, and deployment.
-Provide load testing with proprietary software created by the team and provide metrics

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Conceptualized, designed, implemented, unit tested, peer-reviewed, and released an Art Gallery commerce site for live streaming, tutorials and various art pieces using ASP.NET and Google Cloud Storage and Google Cloud SQL Server. Followed Agile development best practices for design, implementation, and deployment with Github and Heroku, ensuring efficient and collaborative project execution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Maintain and improve a service that will allow users to automate QA validation for the QA Automation team locally and via cloud.
-Use of technologies such as ASP.Net and MySQL, as well as industry best practices for design, implementation, and deployment with Microsoft Azure.
-Provide load testing with proprietary software created by the team and provide metrics with the use of Azure Data Explorer for other teams that create builds to resolve issues within FIS’s SaaS.
-Conceptualize, design, implement, unit test, peer review and release proprietary software that saves FIS millions of dollars a year by automating QA Automation test set validations.
-Implement features to increase the speed of QA Regression tests such as reducing the size of simulated PoS command lists by removing redundant commands, providing a faster Regression cycle.
